effects.description: Sets targets alight, burning for a quarter of the hit every second for 3 s.
Slows targets. Three hits freeze them solid for 2.5 s.
Lightning arcs to another target within 6 m for 60% damage.
Stacks up to 5 times, each stack dealing 12% of the hit every second for 5 s.
35% chance the attack repeats itself a moment later at 60% power.
25% chance to implode, pulling in and hurting everything within 1.8 m.
Stacks up to 3 times, each stack bleeding 15% of the hit every second for 4 s.
Half of hits, and every heavy attack, knock targets off their feet for 0.6 s.
Double damage against targets below 30% health.
20% of damage dealt comes back as mana.
Fires two more projectiles in a spread, at 60% damage.
Projectiles go through up to 2 targets.
Projectiles explode where they land, hurting everything within 2.2 m for 70%.
Projectiles curve towards targets in front of them.

synergies.title: Eclipse
synergies.description: Hitting a burning target consumes the flames in a void explosion. Burning targets it kills explode too, up to 3 in a row.

synergies.title: Stormcaller
synergies.description: Lightning chains through up to 4 targets, each jump hitting 25% harder, up to double.

synergies.title: Widowmaker
synergies.description: Critical hits on bleeding targets siphon three times as much. Killing a bleeding target sends you into a frenzy: 40% faster attacks for 5 s.

synergies.title: Frostbite
synergies.description: Hitting a frozen target shatters the ice for 2.5x damage, chilling everything within 2.5 m.

synergies.title: Gravewhisper
synergies.description: Poisoned targets burst into a toxic cloud when they die, poisoning everything within 3 m, up to 3 in a row.
